def solve(case):
    # validate case
    required_keys = ["word_token_indices", "word_scores", "forced_words", "token_budget"]
    if not all(k in case for k in required_keys):
        raise ValueError("Missing required fields")
    wt = case["word_token_indices"]
    ws = case["word_scores"]
    fw = case["forced_words"]
    budget = case["token_budget"]
    if not isinstance(budget, int) or budget < 0:
        raise ValueError("Invalid budget")
    n = len(wt)
    if n != len(ws):
        raise ValueError("Mismatch lengths")
    token_counts = [len(tokens) for tokens in wt]
    # validate forced words
    forced_set = set(fw)
    if not all(0 <= i < n for i in forced_set):
        raise ValueError("Invalid forced word index")
    forced_sum = sum(token_counts[i] for i in forced_set)
    if forced_sum > budget:
        raise ValueError("Forced words exceed budget")
    remaining_budget = budget - forced_sum
    # selection boolean array
    selected = [False]*n
    for i in forced_set:
        selected[i] = True
    # remaining words
    remaining_indices = [i for i in range(n) if i not in forced_set]
    # sort by descending score, then ascending index
    remaining_indices.sort(key=lambda i: (-ws[i], i))
    for i in remaining_indices:
        tc = token_counts[i]
        if tc <= remaining_budget:
            selected[i] = True
            remaining_budget -= tc
    if remaining_budget != 0:
        raise ValueError("Cannot exactly fill budget")
    # build result
    selected_word_indices = [i for i in range(n) if selected[i]]
    used_tokens = []
    for i in selected_word_indices:
        used_tokens.extend(wt[i])
    total_score = sum(ws[i] for i in selected_word_indices)
    return {
        "selected_word_indices": selected_word_indices,
        "used_token_indices": used_tokens,
        "total_score": total_score,
        "token_usage": budget
    }
